note: Literature directly reports YWHAZ variants causing developmental delay and intellectual disability with brain malformations and anomalies.

evidence.text: A study investigating familial YWHAZ variants identified that YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation, demonstrating brain structure findings on MRI.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation
source.quote: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation

evidence.text: Disease ontology definitions for Popov-Chang syndrome list brain anomalies alongside developmental delay and dysmorphic facies as phenotypic manifestations of YWHAZ variation.

source.title: Popov-Chang syndrome Disease Ontology Browser - DOID:0070709
source.quote: developmental delay, dysmorphic facies, and brain anomalies
